_meta.title: MeteGPT Evidence Log
_meta.purpose: Every claim about a named competitor tool or AI detector published on metegpt.com links to a dated primary source recorded here; article citations like (EV-winston-ai-detector-01) resolve to the matching id below.
_meta.screening_note: Only sources screened INCLUDED under the protocol appear here. Excluded categories -- off-topic, affiliate roundups with no disclosed methodology, sources unverifiable on the collection run, duplicates, and vendor-seeded 'astroturf' review content -- are withheld by design; the protocol never cites them. Each page's collection_sweep publishes the exclusion COUNTS (including how many sources were screened out as astroturf) so the screening is auditable without republishing any withheld source or naming any third party.
_meta.field_note: Internal working fields (coder identities, curator annotations, flow IDs) are omitted. The citable record for each item is its claim, verbatim quote, source URL and source date.
_meta.cross_listed_note: A source that supports claims on more than one page appears under each; unique_sources counts distinct ids, page_appearances counts listings.

entries.claim: A peer-reviewed 14-tool study (Weber-Wulff et al., 2023, International Journal for Educational Integrity) tested the same set of human-written, machine-translated, and AI-generated documents across 14 detection tools and found the tools disagree sharply with each other on identical input: the false-positive risk on the same human-written/machine-translated documents ranged from 0% (Turnitin) to 50% (GPT Zero), and the false-negative risk on the same AI-generated documents ranged from 8% (GPT Zero) to 100% (Content at Scale) -- direct, quantified, peer-reviewed evidence of cross-detector inconsistency on the same text.
entries.quote: The probability of false positives ranged from 0% (Turnitin) to 50% (GPT Zero). The probability of false negatives ranged from 8% (GPT Zero) to 100% (Content at Scale).
entries.source_date: 2023-12-04 (journal publication, International Journal for Educational Integrity, Vol. 19, Article 26); arXiv preprint v2 posted 2023-07-10 (arxiv.org/abs/2306.15666)
entries.platform: peer-reviewed journal (International Journal for Educational Integrity / Springer; also on arXiv, Weber-Wulff et al., 8 authors including Debora Weber-Wulff, HTW Berlin) -- same underlying paper as EV-detect-01/EV-detect-02, this entry registers the section-5.1.2/5.2.1 cross-tool-disagreement finding on the SAME 14-tool, same-document-set test, which was not previously captured in the registry
